$comment: Self-derived finetype drift contract for census/schedule_b, checked by the in-engine finetype_validate@1 gate (the model-free `ft_validate` DuckDB table macro). ft_validate MELTS every column to VARCHAR, so this contract uses ONLY the string-surviving JSON-Schema keywords. ENFORCED: the closed `enum` domains on level, text_source and agricultural (a boolean melts to 'true'/'false'); the `pattern` on code: digits only at 2, 4, 6 or 10 digits, length 2 to 10, the shape descriptor.overrides.json publishes; on code_display, which is dotted: finetype's canonical `geography.transportation.hs_code` validation pattern (`^\d{4}\.?\d{2}(\.?\d{2}){0,2}$`, which admits 6, 8 and 10 digits with or without dots but lacks the 2-digit chapter and 4-digit heading forms) widened by `|^[0-9]{2}$|^[0-9]{4}$`, as describe widens it in the descriptor; `^[0-9]+$` on parent_code, length 2 to 6; the shapes Census prints its line codes in, with the fixed lengths descriptor.overrides.json publishes (sitc three digits then two digits or X, end_use five digits, naics four digits then two digits or X, hitech two digits, units one to three uppercase letters or digits); release as the year folder, '/', and an ISO date; a Roman numeral for section. NOT ENFORCED, by design: numeric ranges (a numeric `type` BACKFIRES to 100% reject once melted to VARCHAR, so depth is left out); NULLs (invisible to ft_validate, and the line columns are NULL on every upper row); object-level `required` (documentation only). Free-text fields (description, description_full, corpus, section_title) carry LOOSE length envelopes with generous headroom, not tight formats. Derived from build/schedule_b.parquet: a pass-through on today's 16,727 rows, a fail-closed tripwire for future drift (an unknown level or text_source, a malformed code, a line code in a new shape).
title: schedule_b
